about_the_game:
Game description

ShipCrafter is an upcoming naval sandbox combat simulator. Build you ship, unlock new parts, and defeat increasingly powerful foes !

Challenge adversaries in the campaign and liberate europe, or battle your own creations in the custom battle mode, and try to come up with the most efficient and original design.

Realtime physics

We want to make a game with accurate physics. As such we implemented a realtime buoyancy system based on weight and submerged volume. The ship density and center of mass is displayed in editor, allowing to fine tune your ship and even make submarines using ballasts !

Weaponery physics were particularly cared for as well, with fully simulated shell trajectories considering air pressure, changes in density through the atmosphere, and the influence of speed on shells drag value. Penetration calculations are calculated based on armor thickness, angle of incidence, bounce probability, and shell speed and mass.

Features

  • 1x1m sized blocks for the highest visual and physical accuracy.

  • Color mode in editor.

  • Realtime buoyancy simulation even considering ocean waves.

  • Various armor thicknesses and accurate penetration calculation based on speed, mass and angle of incidence.

  • Realistic ballistic trajectories even considering changes in the air pressure with altitude. Speeds and distances are however reduced to increase the nervosity of combats (in reality it would take more than a minute to hit a target at 20km).

  • Adjustable ballasts for submarine designs.

  • Physics based damages instead of healthbars. Turrets and engines will also lose performance if hit.

  • Weather system and day cycles, including changes in ocean waves amplitude and raining.

  • Campaign with more than 50 missions.

  • More than 20 different ships to defeat.

  • Custom battle editor.

Planned

  • Adjustable weather and day time for custom mission.

  • More advanced mission editor, and the capability to share it with others.

  • Easier ship files sharing between players.

  • More maps including islands and terrains.

  • More equipment en cosmetics.

Follow the development

Join the discord to discuss of the futur of the game, propose new features, post your creations or simply talk of the military equipment of WWII and connect with the community !
